name: Google Sheets
description: Connect Google Sheets independently to list worksheets, read ranges, and write cells. Google Drive permission is used to access Sheets files; authorization and tokens are managed by the host.
whenToUse: Use this plugin to read or update data in Google Sheets. Connect a Google Sheets account separately in this plugin's details first.

google_sheets_accounts.description: List the Google Sheets accounts connected to this plugin and their status. Accounts must be authorized separately in the Google Sheets plugin details.

google_sheets.description: Run a Google Sheets operation: list_sheets, read_range, or write_range. Before writing cells, show the target range and values to the user and obtain confirmation.

google_sheets_account.label: Google Sheets account
google_sheets_account.hint: Authorize Google Drive access for Sheets files, then connect an account from this plugin's details.
